thread:
marta: Kicking off the Efficiency Navigator (working name). Quick goal: give customers automated, explainable tuning suggestions (batching, KV/prefix caching, quantization) + eval-driven alerts. Want to align on risk gates and rollout plan before we spin up tickets.

leo: solid. two quick asks: 1) default SLO mapping (interactive -> p95, throughput -> p99?) and 2) do we let the recommender propose model swaps as well as quant settings?

jun: recommender can include model variants but only as a "suggestion" with an expected quality delta. we need a quality budget and a clear fallback. suggest API return: suggestion type, expected metric delta, sample prompts used, confidence.

ada: ops concerns: storage of sample traces + eval snapshots for audit. propose retention 30d by default, ops to provide cost per GB/day. also rollout gating: canary 10% -> 50% regional -> 100% global, with an automatic rollback window (5m) if eval-alerts exceed threshold.

infra-bot: ticket created NAV-101: "efficiency-navigator risk gating + telemetry estimates". Assigned: infra. Link: https://tickets.internal/NAV-101 :white_check_mark:

sara: compliance note  for healthcare customers we must persist audit logs in-region. flagging data residency requirement for AcmeHealth pilot.

marta: acceptance criteria draft: - runtime heuristics list (dynamic batching, small-batch mobile, prefix KV caching, soft-token-thresholds) exposed as toggles; - recommender API returns top-3 options with confidence + expected token-cost delta + sample prompts; - eval-alert pipeline configurable per-customer, default threshold 10% regression but can be tightened; - audit trail that stores input sample, decision rationale, and link to eval snapshot for 30d; - safe fallback to float model and ability to pin model/quant.

leo: 10% default sounds reasonable. timeline: phase 1 (fast wins) = runtime heuristics + mobile profile + offline recommender (no auto-apply). phase 2 = API + audit trail + limited auto-apply. phase 3 = full rollout with model variant recs and auto-apply with opt-out.

jun: implementation note: prototype recommender will run offline on sampled request traces. API shape example: POST /v1/navigator/recs { "workload_id": "payday-chat", "sample_prompts": ["..."], "metrics": {"concordance":0.92} } -> response lists suggestions with {"type","params","expected_cost_delta","expected_quality_delta","confidence","rationale_snippet"}.

ada: ops: need storage estimate by Wed to confirm phase-1 windows. also need a small escape hatch in the console to force-disable navigator per-org.

sara: adding legal/regulatory checklist: in-region storage, KMS key binding for audit logs, and export controls for model binaries when recommending quantized variants in private deployments.

marta: action items: infra to post cost estimate (storage + eval runner) by Wed; jun to prepare offline runbook and sample dataset; leo to draft SLO mapping doc; sara/legal to list regulatory constraints for pilot customers. Can we target pilot kickoff in 3 weeks?

leo: yes, aim for pilot with AcmeHealth & PaydayAI in 3 weeks. i'll coordinate with solutions eng. :thumbsup:

marta: thanks all. I'll create NAV-101 subtasks and land an updated acceptance criteria doc. tagging @jun/@ada for any missing gaps. closing thread for now.
